sinopsis.es: De la guerra de Vietnam a las calles de Nueva York, refugiados vietnamitas formaron Born to Kill, la infame pandilla de los 80, unida por la hermandad, la sangre y un mantra: amor, dinero, pecado.
sinopsis.en: From the Vietnam War to the New York streets, Vietnamese refugees built the infamous 80s gang Born to Kill, bound by brotherhood, blood, and the mantra: Love. Money. Sin.
